name: MCIPCBP1
tagline: Fanless industrial edge PC with 2.5GbE and expansion I/O
description: MCIPCBP1 offers J4125, J6412 and selected Intel Core platforms in a fanless aluminum chassis. Dual Intel I225-V 2.5GbE, six RS-232 channels (two DB9 and four through expansion I/O), 10 GPIO and 9-36 V input support equipment integration. RAM and USB depend on the platform; four LAN ports are optional.
